Remark
[Parabolic operators are elliptic at each fixed time] ↗ def:uniform-parabolicity ↗ def:uniform-ellipticity 1. ch7:7.1.1-rem-1\group Parabolic PDE

For every fixed $t\in [0,T]$, $L(t)$ is uniformly elliptic in the spatial variable with ellipticity constant $\theta $.
